$comment: Which GPU tests a machine can run and how it guards its temperature. Choose one with MARGO_MACHINE_PROFILE=<name>; unset means the first profile whose `match` names this platform and CPU architecture (Node process.platform and process.arch), else `default`. Read by scripts/support/machine-profile.mjs for scripts/gpu-package-tests.mjs and scripts/check-merge.mjs. `heat` null means no heat watch. `split` runs heavy suites as short steps. `exclude` records packages this hardware must not run and why.

workstation.description: a desktop with a discrete GPU and active cooling, the maintainer's RTX A6000 PC; every test runs as one step

apple-silicon.description: an Apple silicon Mac (the maintainer's M6 Mac mini, 24 GB unified memory) with WebGPU on Metal; chosen on macOS arm64 when no profile is named; no heat watch, every test runs as one step

mini-pc.description: a small Windows PC with an AMD iGPU; its elevated temperature logger feeds MARGO_THERMAL_FILE

exclude.voxel-pathtracer: the path tracer froze this machine once; it runs only on the workstation profile

laptop.description: a laptop with an integrated GPU (Intel Arc class) and a temperature logger feeding MARGO_THERMAL_FILE; heavy suites run as short steps

thermal-limited.description: a fanless Linux test server with Intel UHD graphics (Mesa) and a 10 W power cap; its heat guard stops jobs at 82 C

exclude.voxel-pathtracer: path tracing at up to 3840 x 2160 holds the GPU at full load for minutes, past this machine's thermal budget even in short steps; it runs on the workstation profile
